exact_certificates.json.description: Frozen author-generated exact QQ(tau) certificates. All d_0 through d_4 values at v=0,1,2 were compared as exact rational basis coefficients against an independently generated prior certificate. Full marker polynomials, Euler derivatives, component constants and logarithmic coefficients were then frozen for reproducible regression. Generation uses the finite Gaussian generator in Report 170; independent ordinary-Taylor/central-binomial numerical comparison is separately enforced.

high_precision.json.description: Frozen author-generated point-valued numerical fixture, generated on 2026-10-03 by a separate 70-digit saddle expansion and checked by a separate Puiseux/Gamma-ratio implementation. Source definitions are the b(u) radical and exact block specification in the cited literature. Values are regression targets, not rigorous interval enclosures.
